name: 01-refined-population
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the APPROVED ORIGINAL illustration and MUST be the visual starting point. Preserve its charming softly illustrated, clean colour-plane style, shallow frontal architectural cutaway, warm sunny mood, gentle character proportions and inviting atmosphere. This is a careful evolution, NOT a new drawing style. NO photography, no realistic faces, no ink outlines or sketchbook texture, no muted sombre 1970s documentary aesthetic, no isometric miniature world, no flat generic corporate noodle people. Retain warmth but increase crispness. Pine #234c40, paper/cream, fresh mineral blue #a5c6d0 and sage #a9cbbb, restrained warm clay accents #d39c80 and natural skin tones. Remove lavender furniture and dominant mustard/yellow lamps; replace with mineral blue, paper or pine. Keep clay roof warm but simpler. Do not make everything beige or dark green. People retain the original illustrated charm with slightly more distinct hair, facial expressions and poses, three-quarter faces and believable activities, not poses of generic smiling stock people. Architecture is quiet and frontal, building coherent and readable. Edit the supplied original image, preserving the central three-storey building silhouette, cutaway room positions, 5 residents, shutters, tiled roof, full framing and cream backdrop. Upper floor: same young adult working, head turned slightly three-quarter toward window, individual curly hair, relaxed posture. Middle floor: same older woman with reading glasses, holding an open book and glancing thoughtfully upward; comfortable blue armchair, remove extra unused sofa and reduce shelf objects. Ground floor: same family of three, child showing a small drawing to two attentive parents with different relaxed poses; small expressive interaction rather than matching seated smiles. Do not add people. Simplify roof tile pattern about half as dense, simplify balcony details, reduce repeated plants and peripheral trees/houses so the main building reads clearly at small size. Use clean bounded colour and only soft shallow interior shadow. Whole structure fully visible with cream margin. No added text, symbols, UI, labels, numbers or logos. Outcome should look unmistakably like a refined version of supplied artwork, not a rebrand.
